newsitem.title: USA: Lazard Freres starts Globex, cuts Lojas Americanas.
newsitem.headline: Lazard Freres starts Globex, cuts Lojas Americanas.

text.p: Lazard Freres said on Wednesday it had started coverage of Brazil's Globex SA as a buy and lowered Lojas Americanas to a hold from moderate outperform.

In a review of leading Brazilian retailers, the brokerage said the stock price did not reflect Globex's quality. It had a "very bullish long-term view" for the company, which operates stores under the Ponto Frio name.
"We believe the stock's current earnings and adjusted cash flow multiples do not adequately reflect the company's strength and prospects," it said.

Lazard Freres lowered its rating for Lojas Americanas based on the "disappointing performance of the company year-to-date and the elevated earnings risk presented by a recent shift toward sales on credit."
The brokerage maintained its buy ratings for Lojas Renner and for Lojas Arapua and a speculative buy rating for Makro. Pao de Acucar retained its hold rating.
